flammability parameters. · Local Sourcing Compliance (Make in India): an affidavit outlining local value addition metrics to s atisfy domestic procurement criteria where applicable. · Tender Acceptance Declaration: Signed and officially stamped letter unconditionally accepting all terms, conditions, and custom Buyer-Added Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC). . : ( ) 3 Folder III Commercial Proposal & Bill of Quantities BOQ SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Subject: Supply of Mandatory Items without Any Additional/Separate Payment. 1. The cost of all these materials shall be deemed to be included in the main co ntract amount. 3.
